subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------INFO.DE.(B)
description: Chart on book p. 29 (BK(NM)-5). C-CONT (composite continuance) is the subject. The title names INFO-DE-(B); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: INFO-DE-B (information degrees), AF-NT (affinity nature), AFI (affinity insight) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From AF-NT: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From AFI: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From T-C-IMP: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and INFO-CON (information convergence). From RT-DY: HI-P (high purpose). From EXP-DY: SCI-DY (scientific dynamics). From INFO-CON: EXT-FT (extended functionalism) and POL-IMP (political implications).
